purpose: Pixel check of the ACOS C1 capture in the WebView bounds (WV7 (c)).
method: ACOS capture steps of scenarios/webview-probe.yaml -> frames/<seq>.png (1080x2400 RGB(A)). WebView A: display rows 700..1260, B: rows 1260..1820, x 21..921 (900x560 device px each, display origin x=21).
run: run ev15 (final broker+provider build, 14/14 steps, verify: pass)

before_fix_WV6.verdict: flat black: the provider's background Paint (default opaque black, never initialised from mBackgroundColor=0xFFFFFFFF) covered the View

region_A_tapped.text: acos asset page / Tap me / not tapped

region_B_tapped.text: acos data page / data page body

after_fix.verdict: PASS: the WebView bounds carry the real page (both pages' text as pixels, 257 colours, black glyphs, no black rectangle), and the before/after captures differ in that region by 55 851 px.

caveat: The FIRST capture is still blank (all white) and the tapped capture still shows the pre-tap DOM text: the page frame is painted only when something else forces a traversal (input, a text change). A frame that arrives after the last draw is not painted until the next draw, because the ART guest does not draw after a View invalidation (evidence/no-draw-after-frame.md).
